description: Cosgrove-PF estimates electromagnetic energy flux into the ionosphere using a statistical reconstruction. FAST satellite observations were grouped in magnetic coordinates to produce the documented Poynting-flux model. The resource is documented by SRI International. The documented physical domain is High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The statistical representation inherits the observational sampling and binning assumptions. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
